remarks: Step into a world of modern elegance and tranquility with this stunning 3-bedroom, duplex-style gem! Nestled in a peaceful cul-de-sac just a heartbeat away from vibrant Downtown Stamford, this home is a masterpiece of light and space. Imagine whipping up gourmet delights in a sleek kitchen adorned with stainless steel appliances and bespoke cabinetry. Unwind in the expansive living area, where gleaming hardwood floors reflect the glow of carefree days, or step outside to your private backyard oasis, complete with a firepit that promises cozy evenings under the stars. With 1 full and 1 half bath, this sanctuary blends convenience with serenity, offering a rare escape from the hustle while keeping you close to the action. Welcome to your perfect retreat-where quiet luxury meets modern living!
